title: Fleet Comeback Shop Fee Refund — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Fee refund on fleet comebacks — Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** On a commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the shop fee refund follows the fees the customer already paid on the original repair, so that no fee is charged twice for the same job.

| Fees on the original repair order | Added to the credit |
|---|---|
| Both a shop supplies fee and a hazardous waste fee | the shop supplies and hazardous waste fees charged on the repeat repair order |
| A shop supplies fee and no hazardous waste fee | the shop supplies fee charged on the repeat repair order |
| Otherwise | no fee |

The repeat repair order is the paid repair order (the repair order of the latest payment received on the account); a fee charged on it that is of a kind the table does not add is not added.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Repeat repair order carrying a shop supplies fee of 17.80 and a hazardous waste fee of 4.95:
- original carried both kinds — 22.75 added;
- original carried shop supplies only — 17.80 added;
- original carried a hazardous waste fee only — nothing added.
